stem: 隐私增强技术(PETS)在反洗钱方面的一个关键优势在于它们能够提供:

options.A: 对底层数据进行同步加密和解密
options.B: 对底层数据的完全访问权限,并能对数据进行完整且不间断的计算.
options.C: 在数据保持加密状态下对其进行安全处理.
options.D: 数据处理者对数据的传输、解密和存储.

stem_en: A key advantage of privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) in anti-money laundering is that they offer:

options_en.A: Simultaneous encryption and decryption of underlying data
options_en.B: Full access to underlying data, with full and uninterrupted calculations made on the data
options_en.C: Secure processing of data while it remains encrypted
options_en.D: Transfer, decryption, and storage of data by the data processor
